evals.prompt: Note for next time: comms could have been better.
evals.expected_output: Asks what specifically happened and its effect, rewrites the lesson into an action a future team could take, asks for evidence and an owner, shows the exact entry and appends only on a yes.
assertions: Turns the vague note into a specific action for next time
Asks for evidence and an owner, or leaves evidence blank and says 'believed'
Shows the exact entry before appending
Does not edit any earlier entry

evals.prompt: Plan a retro for the end of go-live and hypercare.
evals.expected_output: Drafts a session sheet with ground rules, who to invite, the timeline from the record, and five or six go-live prompts from the guide; saves it to docs/change/retros/ on a yes.
assertions: Uses go-live and hypercare prompts, not generic ones
Includes the ground rules about approaches rather than people
Proposes inviting frontline voices or gathering their input through champions
Writes only to docs/change/retros/ after a yes

evals.prompt: Write up the post-mortem for last night's CRM outage.
evals.expected_output: Identifies an IT incident post-mortem and does not log it as a change lesson.
assertions: Identifies the request as an IT post-mortem
